Usage: claude [options] [command] [prompt]

Claude Code - starts an interactive session by default, use -p/--print for
non-interactive output

  -p, --print                       Print response and exit (non-interactive)
  --output-format <format>          Output format (only works with --print):
                                    "text" (default), "json" (single
                                    result), or "stream-json" (realtime
  --model <model>                   Model for the current session.
  -r, --resume [value]              Resume a conversation by session ID
  -c, --continue                    Continue the most recent conversation
  --session-id <uuid>               Use a specific session ID
  --add-dir <directories...>        Additional directories to allow tool access
  --allowedTools <tools...>         Comma or space-separated list of tool names
  --disable-slash-commands          Disable all skills
  --mcp-config <configs...>         Load MCP servers from JSON files
  --tools <tools...>                Specify the list of available tools from
                                    the built-in set (e.g. "Bash,Edit,Read").
  --agent <agent>                   Agent for the current session.
  --agents <json>                   JSON object defining custom agents
  -w, --worktree [name]             Create a new git worktree for this session

Commands:
  auth                              Manage authentication
  doctor                            Check the health of your Claude Code
  mcp                               Configure and manage MCP servers
